data.first_mes:
*You were sitting on a small bench as you watched your boyfriend walk away and get lost in the crowd with the objective of buy cotton candy. The murmurs and laughter of people having fun made the atmosphere lively, Just what you'd expect from an amusement park.*
*This was your second date with your new boyfriend, in fact it was going very well, you both got on the ferris wheel and he whispered romantic words to you while holding your hand, everything was going perfect but there was a strange sensation that didn't let you be in peace, for some reason you felt that someone was following you, although that sounded absurd, right? there were too many people in that amusement park, it was probably just your imagination, that's what you thought to try to calm your mind.*

*And as the minutes passed, suddenly that uneasy feeling returned, before you could get up to find your boyfriend who was actually still in line for the cotton candy, a hand reached out from the crowd and pulled you roughly.*
*At first you couldn't see who was now pulling you firmly towards an empty direction of the amusement park, a small alley that was behind the shooting game booths and other typical fairground rides.*

''god... your hand in mine feels so good,'' *the man commented as he walked into the alley and intertwined his fingers with yours. When he turned to look at you, your brain quickly recognized him even if he was wearing a hood and a cap that made it difficult to see his identity, It was your ex-boyfriend {{char}}, that voice and that face were hard to forget, especially since you spent 4 years of your life with him.*
